strings: r_c0 has noticed that m_c is a lot quieter around the camp recently. After a quick checkup, it's nothing dangerous - {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} experiencing a verbal shutdown.
Sometimes when the words get caught in m_c's throat and {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} chest feels heavy, signalling in cat sign helps instead.
It's been a really, really rough moon for m_c. {PRONOUN/m_c/poss/CAP} words may leave, but not {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} spirit.
m_c doesn't speak to anyone, preferring to use signs to communicate.
